import Mathlib

inductive Color
| Red
| Black
deriving Inhabited, BEq

inductive Node
| Empty : Node
| Tree  (color : Color) (val : Int) (left : Node) (right : Node) : Node
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : Node) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => ∅
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_red (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => true
  | _ => false

def get_color (t : Node) : Color :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree c _ _ _ => c
  | Node.Empty => Color.Black -- Empty nodes are black

def is_bst (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Black Height: Returns -1 if invalid
def black_height (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => 1
  | Node.Tree c _ l r =>
    let lh := black_height l
    let rh := black_height r
    if lh ≠ -1 ∧ rh ≠ -1 ∧ lh = rh then
      if c == Color.Black then lh + 1 else lh
    else
      -1

def satisfies_red_props (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ _ l r =>
    satisfies_red_props l ∧
    satisfies_red_props r ∧
    -- Rule: No Right-Leaning Red
    (¬ is_red r) ∧
    -- Rule: No Double Red on Left
    (match l with
     | Node.Tree Color.Red _ ll _ => ¬ is_red ll
     | _ => True)

-- Main Invariant
def is_llrbt (t : Node) : Prop :=
  is_bst t ∧
  black_height t ≠ -1 ∧
  satisfies_red_props t

def get_left (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.Tree _ _ l _ => some l | _ => none

def get_right (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.Tree _ _ _ r => some r | _ => none

def get_val (t : Node) : Option Int :=
  match t with | Node.Tree _ v _ _ => some v | _ => none

def is_not_empty (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with | Node.Empty => False | _ => True

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def flip_colors_precond (t : Node) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  -- t is not empty
  is_not_empty t ∧
  is_bst t ∧
  match t with
  | Node.Tree c _ l r =>
    is_not_empty l ∧ is_not_empty r ∧
    (get_color l = get_color r) ∧
    (c ≠ get_color l)
  | _ => False
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def flip_color : Color → Color
  | Color.Red => Color.Black
  | Color.Black => Color.Red
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def flip_colors (t : Node) 
    (h_precond : flip_colors_precond t) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | Node.Tree c v
      (Node.Tree lc lv ll lr)
      (Node.Tree rc rv rl rr) =>
    Node.Tree (flip_color c) v
      (Node.Tree (flip_color lc) lv ll lr)
      (Node.Tree (flip_color rc) rv rl rr)
  | _ => t
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def flip_colors_postcond (t : Node) (result : Node)
    (_ : flip_colors_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  view result = view t ∧
  is_bst result ∧ -- Requirement 1: BST structure preserved
  black_height result = black_height t ∧ -- Requirement 2: Balance preserved (Critical)
  match result, t with
  | Node.Tree c' _ l' r', Node.Tree c _ l r =>
      c' ≠ c ∧
      get_color l' ≠ get_color l ∧
      get_color r' ≠ get_color r
  | _, _ => False
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma black_height_bad_or_pos (t : Node) :
    black_height t = -1 ∨ 1 ≤ black_height t := by
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
      exact Or.inr (by norm_num [black_height])
  | Tree c v l r ihl ihr =>
      simp only [black_height]
      by_cases h :
          black_height l ≠ -1 ∧
          black_height r ≠ -1 ∧
          black_height l = black_height r
      · rw [if_pos h]
        cases c with
        | Red =>
            exact ihl
        | Black =>
            rcases ihl with hl | hl
            · exact (h.1 hl).elim
            · exact Or.inr (by omega)
      · rw [if_neg h]
        exact Or.inl rfl

lemma black_height_flip_cluster
    (v lv rv : Int) (ll lr rl rr : Node) :
    black_height
        (Node.Tree Color.Red v
          (Node.Tree Color.Black lv ll lr)
          (Node.Tree Color.Black rv rl rr)) =
      black_height
        (Node.Tree Color.Black v
          (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr)
          (Node.Tree Color.Red rv rl rr)) := by
  have hll : -1 ≤ black_height ll := by
    rcases black_height_bad_or_pos ll with h | h
    · omega
    · omega
  have hlr : -1 ≤ black_height lr := by
    rcases black_height_bad_or_pos lr with h | h
    · omega
    · omega
  have hrl : -1 ≤ black_height rl := by
    rcases black_height_bad_or_pos rl with h | h
    · omega
    · omega
  have hrr : -1 ≤ black_height rr := by
    rcases black_height_bad_or_pos rr with h | h
    · omega
    · omega
  simp [black_height]
  split_ifs <;> omega
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem flip_colors_postcond_satisfied (t : Node)
    (h_precond : flip_colors_precond t) :
    flip_colors_postcond t (flip_colors t h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  cases t with
  | Empty =>
      exact h_precond.1.elim
  | Tree c v l r =>
      have hbst : is_bst (Node.Tree c v l r) := h_precond.2.1
      have hp := h_precond.2.2
      cases l with
      | Empty =>
          exact hp.1.elim
      | Tree lc lv ll lr =>
          cases r with
          | Empty =>
              exact hp.2.1.elim
          | Tree rc rv rl rr =>
              have hcolors :
                  lc = rc := hp.2.2.1
              have hparent :
                  c ≠ lc := hp.2.2.2
              cases c with
              | Red =>
                  cases lc with
                  | Red =>
                      exact (hparent rfl).elim
                  | Black =>
                      cases rc with
                      | Red =>
                          cases hcolors
                      | Black =>
                          unfold flip_colors_postcond
                          dsimp [flip_colors, flip_color]
                          refine ⟨rfl, hbst, ?_, ?_⟩
                          · exact
                              (black_height_flip_cluster
                                v lv rv ll lr rl rr).symm
                          · simp [get_color]
              | Black =>
                  cases lc with
                  | Red =>
                      cases rc with
                      | Red =>
                          unfold flip_colors_postcond
                          dsimp [flip_colors, flip_color]
                          refine ⟨rfl, hbst, ?_, ?_⟩
                          · exact
                              black_height_flip_cluster
                                v lv rv ll lr rl rr
                          · simp [get_color]
                      | Black =>
                          cases hcolors
                  | Black =>
                      exact (hparent rfl).elim
  -- !benchmark @end proof

def view (t : Node) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => ∅
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_red (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => true

  match t with

  | Node.Empty => Color.Black -- Empty nodes are black

def is_bst (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Black Height: Returns -1 if invalid
def black_height (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => 1
  | Node.Tree c _ l r =>
    let lh := black_height l
    let rh := black_height r
    if lh ≠ -1 ∧ rh ≠ -1 ∧ lh = rh then
      if c == Color.Black then lh + 1 else lh
    else
